name: That 70's Band

evidence.note: Band site: NY's leading 70s dance/disco/funk group playing to packed dance floors; lists Oct 3 Car Show LI at Tobay Beach.
Salt Shack artist page tags the band 'Dance' and calls it a high-energy dance band.
Artist bio repeats the 70s dance/disco/funk focus, for weddings and concerts.

dancing.notes: A disco and funk band that says it plays to packed dance floors every week, and beach venues file its shows under 'Dance'. Expect lots of freestyle dancing.

description: New York and Long Island '70s dance band covering disco and funk hits by Earth, Wind & Fire, Kool & the Gang, Donna Summer, Chic and the Bee Gees for concerts, weddings and dinner dances.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Disco crowds sometimes do partner hustle, but no evidence was found for this band, so only freestyle is listed. Oct 3 gig is the Tobay Beach car show.
